entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: From the perusal of the records of this case, it appears that the notification under Section 11(1) as contained in Annexure-4 dated 05.11.2022 was issued and objection was to be filed before the District Land Acquisition Officer, Sahebganj, but the petitioners had filed their so-called objection before the Deputy Commissioner, Sahebganj and in the said objection, it has also been mentioned that they have no objection with regard to acquisition, but what they are looking for is appropriate compensation.

It further transpires that subsequent notification as per the timeline prescribed under the Act, 2013 has also been issued under Section 19(1) as contained in Annexure-7.
5.
Since the learned counsel for the petitioners is praying for time, post these cases on 27.07.2023 under the heading for 'Fresh Filing'.
